purpose: Private Hollywood and Vine room styling demo; visual stand-ins, not photos of the shop's actual inventory
method: Web image search; direct downloads; visual inspection against local stills and crop; Pillow verification of dimensions and alpha extrema

items.title: Pair of Pharaoh table lamps, gold bust with rectangular cream shade
items.suitability: Best found match for the reference's gold Egyptian-style head and wide cream rectangular shade. Bust is a different sculpture and base is light rather than green; suitable only as a private visual stand-in.

alternatives.title: Gold Pharaoh bust lamp with pale pleated shade
alternatives.suitability: More polished gold and shade texture, but curved shade differs from reference.

items.title: Brass oil lamp with clear glass chimney
items.suitability: Squat polished brass font, stepped base and clear glass chimney resemble the reference. Single lamp represents a pair in the source inventory; different glass profile.

alternatives.title: Antique brass oil lamp with clear glass chimney
alternatives.suitability: Good full-object packshot, but taller and slimmer than the reference.

items.title: Crosley Lancaster Entertainment Center, paprika finish, lid closed
items.suitability: Closest clean packshot: closed reddish wood tabletop cabinet, central round radio dial, side speaker grilles. Reference has horizontal louvered side grilles and a taller box, so this is a style match rather than the same model.

alternatives.title: Thomas Pacconi Museum Series closed wood record player
alternatives.suitability: Central circular dial and closed lid closer to reference; lower resolution and scene background make it a weaker overlay source.

alternatives.title: Transparent Crosley-style wood record player
alternatives.suitability: Real transparent pixels and wood front with grille, but open lid and low quality; not preferred for room overlay.

items.title: Veneto Ballet pink champagne coupes, set of four
items.suitability: Four complete rose-pink coupes match the reference's coupe grouping, though the actual shelf also includes flutes. Glass bowls retain white backdrop through the glass; a naive cutout will look wrong on burgundy.

companion.title: Meridian blush champagne flutes, set of four
companion.suitability: Tall pale-pink flutes complete the mixed shelf look.

alternatives.title: Vintage Rosaline pink champagne flutes
alternatives.suitability: Vintage peach tint closer to reference, but stems and bowls are more ornate than the actual flutes.
